question: Score LiteInst cross-backend DETLOG parity against the ptrace golden, per cell, with denominators, and record per-cell self-determinism rather than inheriting the single 0/1245 datum.

base.note: 0041130c is an ancestor of main, so this arm describes LANDED behaviour.

fix.note: Head of open PR #1847. NOT landed.

method.collection: harness/detlog_collect.sh <hermit> <outdir> <runs>; hermit --log=info [--backend=liteinst] run --strict --base-env=minimal -- <guest>, stderr filtered with grep -o 'DETLOG .*'
method.no_memory_hash_flags: DETLOG is measured as its OWN emission stream. --detlog-stack/--detlog-heap are deliberately NOT passed, so a stack result can neither be inferred from this nor contaminate it.

policies.hex: 0x<hex> -> HEX, verbatim the normalisation ci-hub/parity/prefix_depth.sh already applies in commits(); not invented here

metrics.Z: ptrace golden DETLOG record count (the denominator for every row of that cell)
metrics.prefix_depth: length of the identical leading run, the house ratchet's monotonic measure
metrics.covered: order-preserving longest-common-subsequence of the golden inside the candidate
metrics.candidate_inserted: E - covered; reported separately and NEVER subtracted from the score

cells: detlog_syscalls, heap_fragment_reuse, stack_deep_recursion, stdout_bytes (ci-hub/parity/guests/*.c, the pinned per-dimension reference guests)
known_confound_controlled: LiteInst stack/DETLOG content depends on the hermit binary's install PATH (LD_PRELOAD absolute path is in the guest environment block). Every arm here was driven from a fixed path per binary. See experiments/liteinst-maps-inode-self-determinism_20260807 section 5.
